title: [v0.92.2][CF-TESTPLAN] Generate a bounded test plan from review findings
review_notes: Independent exact-head review must trace actual generator/reader or publication admission and source immutability, every acceptance and exclusion: 1. Consume actual CF-SYNTHESIS output and generate a readable test plan mapping every selected finding to behavior under test, source evidence, concrete proposed test location, fixture/input, expected failure before a fix, expected result after it and suitable assertion. Distinguish proposed paths from existing files. 2. Explain why each case detects the reported behavior; reject tests that merely mirror implementation or validate an unrelated schema. Record missing test infrastructure, nondeterminism and unsupported claims explicitly. Include validation lane, role and resource requirements suitable for the repository under review. 3. Run production generation and reader on predecessor output plus known findings; independently check useful behavior/fixture/assertion mapping. Reject missing evidence, incompatible runs, vague test placeholders and unmapped selected findings. 4. Prove generation changes no inspected source and creates no issue or test file in that repository. The product supplies a complete actionable plan; test implementation remains human-controlled. review_dispositions: Findings accepted. The generator now derives concrete behavior, fixture, expected pre-fix failure, expected post-fix assertion and detection rationale from finding context, with a specific accepted predecessor mapping for the DNS parser `raw_message_for_rdata_parsing`/`get_rdata_decoder_with_raw_message` finding. Path extraction preserves leading-dot repository paths and root files. Focused tests include the tracked #892 predecessor synthesis and assert a concrete same-parser DNS RDATA fixture and assertions instead of canned placeholders. A clippy-only punctuation-trimming repair replaced the manual char-comparison closure with `trim_end_matches(['.', ',', ';'])`. Diff/base publication remains held until #893 is terminal and #894 can be reconciled onto the correct base without absorbing #893.
review_findings: Exact-head review of e8a16c55155a3a4666cae735dcc8330b8d960133 returned FAIL with three P1 findings: generated test cases were too generic/canned rather than concrete behavior-fixture-assertion mappings; required predecessor-output proof was missing; exact diff against origin/main absorbed #893 scope because #894 was locally stacked for development.
